classes.Details: This program focuses on gentle water stretching, range-of-motion exercises, muscle strengthening and relaxation techniques, taught in a warm pool. For drop-in aquafit, you must register in person at the pool office. Registration opens 30 minutes before the start of the class. It is first come, first serve.

Strengthen your core while enjoying the benefits of water-based exercise! Aqua Core is a low-impact fitness class designed to target your abdominal, back, and pelvic muscles using the natural resistance of water. Through a series of dynamic movements and stabilization exercises, participants will improve posture, balance, and overall core strength. Ideal for all fitness levels, this class is perfect for those seeking a challenging workout without the stress on joints. No swimming skills required—just bring your energy and get ready to make a splash!
